{
  "dataset_name": "law_school_admission_bianry",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-opus-4.7",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "lsat_z_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Standardized LSAT score centered on training mean and scaled by training std, useful as a linear projection.",
      "value_range": [-5.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "standardization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a smooth normalized continuous input ideal for SVM margin computation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(lsat - 36.8186) / 5.3451"
    },
    {
      "name": "decile_avg",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Average of the two decile rankings, providing a smoother academic standing measure.",
      "value_range": [1.0, 10.0],
      "feature_family": "aggregate",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Reduces noise in decile signals and produces a single linear-friendly academic ranking.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(decile1 + decile3) / 2.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "decile_progression",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Change between later and earlier decile rankings indicating academic trajectory.",
      "value_range": [-9.0, 9.0],
      "feature_family": "trend",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures linear directional signal about improvement or decline in standing.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "decile3 - decile1"
    },
    {
      "name": "lsat_per_decile",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of LSAT score to mean decile ranking capturing efficiency of test performance vs class rank.",
      "value_range": [1.5, 48.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Composite ratio yields a stable linear discriminator.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "lsat / np.maximum((decile1 + decile3) / 2.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "academic_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of standardized LSAT, decile, and undergraduate GPA representing overall academic strength.",
      "value_range": [-6.0, 6.0],
      "feature_family": "composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aligns multiple correlated academic indicators into a single linear-margin-friendly axis.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "0.4 * ((lsat - 36.8186) / 5.3451) + 0.3 * ((decile1 + decile3) / 2.0 - 5.657) / 2.8 + 0.3 * (ugpa - 3.2265) / 0.4136"
    },
    {
      "name": "fam_inc_normalized",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Family income scaled to [0,1] range for smooth socioeconomic signal.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "normalization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Bounded normalized feature suitable for linear SVM weighting.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(fam_inc - 1.0) / 4.0"
    },
    {
      "name": "age_centered",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Age centered on training mean and scaled by std for smooth deviation measure.",
      "value_range": [-12.0, 2.0],
      "feature_family": "standardization",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides centered numeric input avoiding scale dominance in linear models.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(age - 59.0846) / 5.257"
    },
    {
      "name": "ugpa_lsat_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative interaction between standardized GPA and LSAT capturing joint academic strength.",
      "value_range": [-15.0, 15.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Adds a nonlinear interaction term as a linear feature improving SVM separability.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "((lsat - 36.8186) / 5.3451) * ((ugpa - 3.2265) / 0.4136)"
    },
    {
      "name": "fulltime_indicator",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Binary indicator of full-time status (1 if fulltime category is 1).",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Clean binary signal directly usable in linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.where(fulltime == '1', 1.0, 0.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "cluster_tier_score",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Ordinal semantic ranking of school cluster tiers mapped to a smooth severity score where lower cluster numbers indicate different program tiers (1->0.8, 2->0.6, 3->0.5, 4->0.4, 5->0.3, 6->0.2).",
      "value_range": [0.2, 0.8],
      "feature_family": "semantic_encoding",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Translates categorical cluster into smooth ordered numeric feature for linear margin.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "decile_consistency",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Inverse absolute deviation between two deciles indicating consistency of academic performance.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "consistency",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth bounded score rewarding stable academic profiles, helpful for linear separation.",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "1.0 / (1.0 + np.abs(decile3 - decile1))"
    },
    {
      "name": "demographic_advantage_judgment",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic composite reflecting demographic and socioeconomic context combining gender, race, and family income into a smooth normalized score representing structural opportunity context.",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "semantic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures non-formulaic interpretable demographic context as a linear feature aiding margin calibration.",
      "leakage_risk": "medium",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    }
  ]
}
